description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Generator, responsible for generating sanitized HTML code from tokens. It contains methods for token processing, attribute generation, and optional formatting like tidy and newline normalization, as well as internal properties for configuration and state.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating HTML output from tokens, with configurable options for XHTML output, scripting comments, and formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the generator with configuration and context, setting internal properties based on config options.

methods.name: generateFromTokens
methods.description: Creates HTML string from an array of tokens, handling script tags specially if configured, and optionally tidying up the output.

methods.name: generateFromToken
methods.description: Converts a single token into its corresponding HTML representation.

methods.name: generateScriptFromToken
methods.description: Processes script content tokens to safely embed them with comment and CDATA wrappers.

methods.name: generateAttributes
methods.description: Builds an attribute string for an element from an attribute array, considering minimization and sorting.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: HTML-escapes a string, with configurable quoting, used for attribute and text data.
